notes.title: Patch v0.7.4a
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v0.7.4a-demo
Released on July 18, 2025


New Features
3 new original soundtracks:

  - Lysari's Journey

  - The Heart of the Wolf

  - Ascension



General Updates
Replaced the Kickstarter Logo/button with a "Read the Patch Notes" button.

Fixed the first time game launch selected language not taking immediate effect.

Fixed the cursor being invisible on the first time game launch screen.

Updated the default settings at first time game launch (slightly higher starting resolution, sound and music volume set to 100%).

Fixed a typo with the support email address in the game credits.

Fixed wrong movement speed value in the Swift Storm buff description.

Updated the "Maximum FPS" slider in the settings menu and removed the percentage symbol.

Fixed a typo with Lysari's Swift Storm ability description.

Fixed the missing localisation for "Unit dropped Item!" e.g., "Goblin Rogue dropped Lucky Charm!"



Visual Updates
The amount of random grass spawned per sector increased from 25 to 40 per sector to 50 to 62 per sector.

notes.title: Patch v0.7.4-demo
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v0.7.4-demo

Released on April 9, 2025


General Updates


 Fixed unit upgrades from tech tree not being applied correctly.
 Fixed Farm building portrait slightly falling outside of the left side of the portrait box.
 Fixed unit upgrades with more than two not stacking correctly within the bottom HUD upgrades box.
 Fixed Archer unit Hawkeye upgrade always applying a critical hit.
 Adjusted Hero items in the bottom HUD so they are no longer centered within the items box.
 Fixed Heroes not automatically consuming their consumable items when conditions are met.
 Fixed Lysari's Swiftstorm buff applying inconsistently to friendly units.
 Fixed issue where Heroes could get stuck in an infinite loop trying to pick up items with a full inventory.
 Added missing item stats to hover information box localizations.
 Fixed Lucky Charm item bonus stats not applying to Heroes.
 Fixed enemy unit upgrades not always displaying in the bottom HUD.
 Fixed Hero unit active ability cooldown timer not showing the full duration.
 Fixed selected unit(s) not being deselected when deployed to a different sector.
 Added missing localization for “Hero inventory is full!”
 Added missing localization for “Hero AoE damage increased!”
 Added missing localization for “Hero reached level X!”
 Added missing localization for “Hero dropped item!”



Gameplay Changes

Hero Balance

Valdern


 Health reduced from 700 → 400
 Armour reduced from 20 → 8
 Damage changed from 30–45 → 26–32
 Health regen reduced from 3 → 1
 Evasion rate reduced from 8% → 2%
 Critical chance increased from 10% → 12%


Lysari


 Health reduced from 500 → 300
 Armour reduced from 12 → 6
 Damage changed from 40–55 → 34–41
 Evasion rate reduced from 12% → 4%



Hero XP Rewards (from kills)


 Knights: 35 → 40 XP
 Archers: 25 → 30 XP
 Wizards: 25 → 32 XP
 Shieldbreakers: 35 → 44 XP
 Goblin Rogues: 20 → 25 XP
 Goblin Lancers: 20 → 28 XP
